AUTHOR: Muntaner-Gonzalez
TITLE: Automatic deep learning-based pipeline for Mediterranean fish segmentation
REGION: Western Mediterranean: Balearic Islands / Spanish coast (IMEDEA Sub-Eye, OBSEA observatory Catalonia, Minka citizen-science photos; field tests at Port de Soller)
SPECIES: Diplodus vulgaris, D. sargus, D. annularis, Spondyliosoma cantharus, Seriola dumerili, Chromis chromis, Oblada melanura, Coris julis, Mugilidae, Lithognathus mormyrus, Sciaena umbra, Spicara maena, Serranus scriba, S. cabrilla, Dentex dentex, Pomatomus saltatrix, Epinephelus marginatus
DATA: New instance-segmentation dataset of 4,635 images (15,025 instances) compiled from IMEDEA and OBSEA Roboflow datasets and Minka database; SAM-assisted masks; 98-image independent field-test set from own stereo vision system; DeepFish segmentation set (310 images) for single-class generalisation
V_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'a dataset with a variety of backgrounds, light conditions, and resolutions is generated'; Sec. 6: 'variations in species appearance due to changing lighting and water conditions'
D_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'The dataset is split into a trainval partition composed of 4,173 images (90% of the data) and a test partition composed of 462 images (10% of the data).'
R_EV: Sec. 5.1: 'some of the images recorded during field tests have been manually labelled to serve as an independent test set' ; Table 8 per-class mAP50 (e.g. Chromis chromis 0.831/0.821)
C_EV: Sec. 5: 'If a fish is detected with a confidence level above a predefined threshold, the image is stored' (value not given); Sec. 4: 'errors stem from missed or confused detections rather than FPs'
E_EV: Sec. 4: 'evaluated on the test partition, obtaining an mAP50(B) of 0.886 and an mAP50(M) of 0.890' (detection/segmentation metrics only)
ARCH: YOLOv8l-seg (COCO-pretrained, imgsz 1280, SGD lr 0.01, custom augmentation incl. copy-paste, cls_loss 8); YOLOv8n-seg deployed on ROS-based stereo vision system; SAM used for semi-automatic mask labelling
METR: mAP50(B), mAP50(M), per-class mAP50, F1-score (0.853), confusion matrix, inference time
NOTE: Segmentation/detection benchmark with field deployment; no ecological output beyond detections (the SVS logs 'number of detections' but these are not evaluated). PLAT=혼합: training images come from a cabled observatory (OBSEA), the IMEDEA Sub-Eye observatory and citizen-science photographs (Minka), while field tests use the authors' fixed stereo vision system. V: only qualitative mentions of varied light/water conditions; no stratified results. D: the 90/10 split is defined in images and the unit/randomisation is not stated; most images are independent stills rather than video frames, so leakage risk is lower than for frame splits, but no de-duplication or leakage discussion -> D_ALL=N (verifier may consider D1=NR). R_ALL=Y: 98 manually labelled images from the authors' own SVS deployments (different camera/site, 4 species) evaluated quantitatively (Table 8), plus single-class generalisation to DeepFish (Table 5). C1=NR: a 'predefined' storage confidence threshold is mentioned without a value and no evaluation threshold is reported; FP vs FN discussed qualitatively -> C_ALL=NR. Trained model and dataset released on Zenodo (DSHR=공개); source code release not stated (CODE=N). Note: the Zenodo link in the data availability statement contains an access token.
